doc.brief: The QStyle class is an abstract base class that encapsulates the look and feel of a GUI.
doc.index_brief: Abstract base class that encapsulates the look and feel of a GUI

QIcon standardIcon(QStyle::StandardPixma.brief: Returns an icon for the given *standardIcon*.

QPixmap generatedIconPixmap(QIcon::Mode.brief: Returns a copy of the given *pixmap*, styled to conform to the specified *iconMode* and taking into account the palette specified by *option*.

QPoint visualPos(Qt::LayoutDirection dir.brief: Returns the given *logicalPosition* converted to screen coordinates based on the specified *direction*.

QRect alignedRect(Qt::LayoutDirection di.brief: Returns a new rectangle of the specified *size* that is aligned to the given *rectangle* according to the specified *alignment* and *direction*.

QRect itemPixmapRect(const QRect &rectan.brief: Returns the area within the given *rectangle* in which to draw the specified *pixmap* according to the defined *alignment*.

QRect itemTextRect(const QFontMetrics &m.brief: Returns the area within the given *rectangle* in which to draw the provided *text* according to the specified font *metrics* and *alignment*.

QRect subControlRect(QStyle::ComplexCont.brief: Returns the rectangle containing the specified *subControl* of the given complex *control* (with the style specified by *option*).

QRect subElementRect(QStyle::SubElement.brief: Returns the sub-area for the given *element* as described in the provided style *option*.

QRect visualRect(Qt::LayoutDirection dir.brief: Returns the given *logicalRectangle* converted to screen coordinates based on the specified *direction*.

QSize sizeFromContents(QStyle::ContentsT.brief: Returns the size of the element described by the specified *option* and *type*, based on the provided *contentsSize*.

QString name() const.brief: Returns the name of the style.

QStyle::SubControl hitTestComplexControl.brief: Returns the sub control at the given *position* in the given complex *control* (with the style options specified by *option*).

const QStyle * proxy() const.brief: This function returns the current proxy for this style.

int combinedLayoutSpacing(QSizePolicy::C.brief: Returns the spacing that should be used between *controls1* and *controls2* in a layout. *orientation* specifies whether the controls are laid out side by side or stacked vertically.

int layoutSpacing(QSizePolicy::ControlTy.brief: Returns the spacing that should be used between *control1* and *control2* in a layout. *orientation* specifies whether the controls are laid out side by side or stacked vertically.

int pixelMetric(QStyle::PixelMetric metr.brief: Returns the value of the given pixel *metric*.

int sliderPositionFromValue(int min, int.brief: Converts the given *logicalValue* to a pixel position.

int sliderValueFromPosition(int min, int.brief: Converts the given pixel *position* to a logical value. 0 maps to the *min* parameter, *span* maps to *max* and other values are distributed evenly in-between.

int styleHint(QStyle::StyleHint hint, co.brief: Returns an integer representing the specified style *hint* for the given *widget* described by the provided style *option*.

void drawComplexControl(QStyle::ComplexC.brief: Draws the given *control* using the provided *painter* with the style options specified by *option*.

void drawControl(QStyle::ControlElement.brief: Draws the given *element* with the provided *painter* with the style options specified by *option*.

void drawItemPixmap(QPainter *painter, c.brief: Draws the given *pixmap* in the specified *rectangle*, according to the specified *alignment*, using the provided *painter*.

void drawItemText(QPainter *painter, con.brief: Draws the given *text* in the specified *rectangle* using the provided *painter* and *palette*.

void drawPrimitive(QStyle::PrimitiveElem.brief: Draws the given primitive *element* with the provided *painter* using the style options specified by *option*.

void polish(QApplication *application).brief: Late initialization of the given *application* object.

void polish(QPalette &palette).brief: Changes the *palette* according to style specific requirements for color palettes (if any).

void polish(QWidget *widget).brief: Initializes the appearance of the given *widget*.
